dct_description_sm: Stable isotope ratios of carbon and nitrogen (measured using IRMS) and trace element concentrations (measured using LA-ICP-MS) in growth layer groups in beluga whale teeth were collected to determined seasonal and interannual patterns in diet and migration. Teeth were collected from subsistence harvested whales from the Cumberland Sound, Western Hudson Bay, and Eastern High Arctic-Baffin Bay populations.
dct_title_s: Stable isotopes and trace elements in teeth of eastern Canadian Arctic beluga whales (Delphinapterus leucas)
